Resolve a single Risk dice duel

Source: R/combat.R
rk_duel.Rd

Resolves one throw of the dice in a Risk battle. The attacker rolls n_att dice and the defender n_def dice; the highest attacker die is compared with the highest defender die, then (if both rolled at least two dice) the second-highest pair. The attacker removes a defending army when strictly higher; ties and lower rolls remove an attacking army.

Usage

rk_duel(n_att, n_def, max_def = 2L)

Arguments

n_att

Number of attacker dice (1-3).

n_def

Number of defender dice (1-2; up to 3 in older variants).

max_def

Maximum defender dice permitted by the ruleset. Defaults to 2L; set to 3L for the older variant.

Value

A list with four elements: att_loss and def_loss (integers summing to min(n_att, n_def), the number of compared dice pairs), and att_roll and def_roll, the integer dice rolls sorted in decreasing order.

See also

rk_duel_odds() for the exact outcome probabilities.

Other combat: rk_battle(), rk_battle_odds(), rk_duel_dist(), rk_duel_odds(), rk_odds_table()

Examples

set.seed(1)
rk_duel(3, 2)
#> $att_loss
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $def_loss
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $att_roll
#> [1] 4 1 1
#> 
#> $def_roll
#> [1] 5 2
#>
